sequential_dependency.intermediate: The count-sized backing grid of palette colors before nonzero stencil overlay.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Count the two upper quadrants, recover the palette and stencil, and build the count-sized backing grid using the selected block or periodic sampling rule.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Repeat the lower-right stencil and paint its nonzero cells over the backing, exposing the backing at stencil-zero positions.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The colors exposed at stencil holes depend on the measured output dimensions and palette indexing. Holding dimensions and stencil fixed while replacing the backing with zeros changes the final output.
